races.title: Sebden Steel Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: An interesting opener. A big-field bumper win at the spring festival here marks down DELAMOTTE as one who can do well over hurdles for his top stable. Kingstonian rates an obvious danger after 2 good placed efforts since switched to hurdles. Brady Hartsfield and Bacharach should have more to offer on the back of promising hurdle debuts. Point recruit Menethil is the mount of Jack Kennedy from the Gordon Elliott quintet. DELAMOTTE (FR) KINGSTONIAN BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE)

races.title: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
races.verdict: After only the 2 outings over hurdles, MIGHTY PARK looks an exciting prospect for chasing and starts off in a race in which Willie Mullins tends to introduce one of his better novices, Gaelic Warrior landing the prize in 2023. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate Saint Baco , with Fierce Handay and Powerful others to consider. MIGHTY PARK (IRE) SAINT BACO (FR) FIERCE HANDAY (IRE)

races.title: Boodles Florida Pearl Novice Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict: KISS WILL remains a maiden over fences but sets the standard on the pick of last season's form and should prove hard to beat if returning near that level. Ballygunner Castle is feared most back in novice company after improving to land a notable handicap last time, while The Big Clubman is also respected stepped back up in trip. KISS WILL (FR) BALLYGUNNER CASTLE (IRE) THE BIG CLUBMAN (IRE)

races.title: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase
races.verdict: PREDATORS GOLD likely would have won a Grade 1 novice last season but for a late mishap and, with Paul Townend keeping the faith, is taken to make a successful handicap debut. Letos is feared most despite being out of the weights given how well treated he looks on last season's hurdles form, while Argento Boy may need a stiffer test but appeals for minor honours. PREDATORS GOLD (FR) LETOS (FR) ARGENTO BOY (IRE)

races.title: Total Event Rental 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict: MOMENTUM OF LOVE arrives on the back of a hurdling success in France and is expected to maintain her unbeaten record now starting out for powerful connections. Danny Power has taken well to hurdling and is feared most, while newcomer Rio de La Pampa is also one to consider for a yard known for unearthing promising recruits. MOMENTUM OF LOVE (FR) DANNY POWER (IRE) RIO DE LA PAMPA (FR)

races.title: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series At Punchestown Festival 2027 Qualifier Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: THANKYOUFORTHEDAYS showed improved form when winning last season and returns from a summer break still relatively unexposed. The longer trip should play to his strengths and he's taken to make a winning return. Tangara Bay is on the comeback trail but represents a yard in red-hot form and is feared most after just a handful of starts, while both Jacovec Cavern and Sonny May are respected. THANKYOUFORTHEDAYS (IRE) TANGARA BAY (FR) JACOVEC CAVERN

races.title: WTW Willis (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: MISTER BOUM ran out an easy winner of his sole start in points and makes plenty of appeal on his Rules debut having joined all-conquering yard. Chanson du Jury is another fascinating contender having changed hands for big money on the back of a point success, while Ifuknowuknow is a likeable sort who should give his running once again. MISTER BOUM (FR) CHANSON DU JURY (IRE) IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)
